title: AccordTrace Evaluation
subtitle: M&A evidence copilot | Independent testbed
footer: AccordTrace | Evaluation evidence, not a legal accuracy certification

annotated_span_coverage_all.interpretation: Fraction of labelled source code points covered by the full captured evidence packet, unioning overlaps. Partial coverage does not establish complete legal support.

annotated_span_coverage_at_3.interpretation: Labelled source code-point coverage within the first three excerpts, unioning overlaps.

annotated_span_coverage_at_6.interpretation: Labelled source code-point coverage within the first six excerpts, unioning overlaps.

evidence_recall_at_3.interpretation: Fraction of labelled evidence units at least 95% covered within three excerpts. A source-overlap threshold, not a legal completeness judgement.

answer_emission_rate.interpretation: Fraction of eligible answerable cases with emitted claims. Measures answer production, not correctness; service failures are excluded.

chat_scope_valid.interpretation: Fraction of captured chat scopes matching the pinned conversation scope. Mechanical access/snapshot consistency.

citation_count.interpretation: Mean number of citations in captured answers. A count with no assumed optimal direction.

returned_evidence_count.interpretation: Mean number of returned evidence items. Larger packets are not necessarily better retrieval.

evidence_recall_at_6.label: Evidence recall @6
evidence_recall_at_6.interpretation: Fraction of labelled evidence units at least 95% covered within six excerpts. Higher is better; source-label coverage does not prove legal completeness.

mrr.label: Reciprocal rank
mrr.interpretation: Rank of the first excerpt with at least 50% overlap of a labelled evidence unit. Undefined for cross-agreement ranking.

citation_integrity.interpretation: Mechanical validation of citation scope, source identity, hashes, offsets and exact quotes. Does not establish that a claim follows from its citation.

ragas_citation_groundedness_proxy.interpretation: Judge support against final cited quotes only. This is not faithfulness against the actual generation context.

ragas_context_recall.interpretation: Judge-estimated support of reference claims by the captured search context. Separate search results are not necessarily generation context.

ragas_context_precision.interpretation: Judge-estimated relevance and ordering of retrieved contexts against the reference. Not available for a global rank across agreement groups.

ragas_response_relevancy.interpretation: Question/answer relevance using Gemini judgement and local Ollama embedding similarity. Relevance is not factual correctness.

ragas_factual_correctness.interpretation: Judge comparison of answer claims against the reference. Limited by reference completeness and judge reliability.

false_abstention_rate.interpretation: Lower is better. Fraction of eligible answerable cases receiving insufficient-evidence abstention; operational failures are excluded.

scope_violation_count.interpretation: Lower is better. Count of returned evidence items outside the requested agreement scope.
